hypotheses.title: Consensus Dividend Yield Percentile Dislocation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consensus Dividend Per Share (anl4_afv4_div_mean, Matrix 82% coverage) measures anticipated cash distributions to shareholders. Dividing by spot price (anl4_afv4_div_mean / close) provides a forward-looking dividend yield. By comparing this yield against its own trailing 60-day historical range via ts_rank, we isolate temporary dividend yield spikes caused by transient price pullbacks in stable, cash-generative firms. Ranking within subindustries insulates against structural yield differences across defensive versus growth sectors.
confounders: Distressed companies where impending dividend cuts have not yet been reflected in sell-side consensus estimates
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if dividend yield percentile yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of 60-day rolling time-series rank of consensus dividend yield.

hypotheses.title: Actual Annual Earnings Yield Accretion Dislocation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Annual Reported Diluted EPS (anl4_af_eps_value, Matrix 100% coverage across US Equities) reflects audited bottom-line profitability. Scaling by spot stock price (anl4_af_eps_value / close) yields the classical earnings-to-price ratio. Normalizing this earnings yield against its 60-day trailing historical percentile distribution via ts_rank identifies equities experiencing temporary intra-industry price drops while underlying accounting earnings remain rock solid.
confounders: Highly cyclical commodity firms whose historical peak earnings are about to collapse due to commodity price downturns
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if earnings yield percentile yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of 60-day rolling time-series rank of actual earnings yield.

hypotheses.title: Enterprise Sales Yield Cyclical Valuation Dislocation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Actual Net Sales (actual_sales_value_annual, Matrix 99% coverage) sits at the top of the income statement, completely immune to discretionary accounting accruals, working capital adjustments, or tax items. Dividing net sales by market capitalization (actual_sales_value_annual / cap) creates a robust sales-to-price ratio. Comparing this sales yield to its 60-day rolling distribution via ts_rank captures firms whose market valuation has dropped excessively relative to their aggregate commercial revenue engine.
confounders: Low-margin high-volume retail businesses with structural margin compression where revenue does not translate into cash flow
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if sales yield percentile yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of 60-day rolling time-series rank of annual sales-to-capitalization ratio.
